description: Test suite for Custom Profile Attributes (CPA) feature in Mattermost, including CRUD operations, validation, and default attribute initialization.

methods.name: TestGetCPAField
methods.description: Tests retrieving CPA fields, including non-existent, from different groups, and default attribute initialization.

methods.name: TestListCPAFields
methods.description: Tests listing CPA fields, default attribute initialization, and handling of fields with missing or empty attrs.

methods.name: TestCreateCPAField
methods.description: Tests creation of CPA fields, including validation, limits, and handling of DeleteAt.

methods.name: TestPatchCPAField
methods.description: Tests updating CPA fields, including option ID preservation, type changes, and value deletion upon type change.

methods.name: TestDeleteCPAField
methods.description: Tests deletion of CPA fields, including associated values and soft delete behavior.

methods.name: TestGetCPAValue
methods.description: Tests retrieving CPA values, including non-existent, array handling, and validation.

methods.name: TestListCPAValues
methods.description: Tests listing all CPA values for a user, including empty states.

methods.name: TestPatchCPAValue
methods.description: Tests creating and updating CPA values, handling array values, validation, and type changes.

methods.name: TestDeleteCPAValues
methods.description: Tests bulk deletion of CPA values for a user, including handling of non-existent and other users' data.
